page.title: Gift cards
page.subtitle: Every gift card you sold, with its balance and history.
page.info: A gift card is a balance in your customer's favor. It's sold at the point of sale and used to pay at your business.
page.settingsError: We couldn't read how gift cards are set up.

notice.DISABLED: Gift cards are turned off: no new ones are sold. The ones you already sold can still be used to pay.
notice.NOT_IN_PLAN: Your plan no longer includes selling gift cards. The ones you sold can still be used to pay, and you can keep seeing them here.
notice.KEYS_MISSING: Avoqado still has a step to finish before you can sell gift cards. Write to us at hola@avoqado.io.

turnOn.title: Sell gift cards
turnOn.body: Your customers gift balance to spend at your business. First turn them on in Settings.
turnOn.askOwner: Ask the owner or a manager to turn them on in Settings.

teaser.title: What you can do with gift cards
teaser.sell: Sell them at the point of sale, from $100 to $10,000.
teaser.pay: Take payments with the balance, all of it or part.
teaser.track: See the balance and history of each card.

list.searchPlaceholder: Search by last 4, name, phone or email
list.emptyTitle: You haven't sold any gift cards yet
list.emptyBody: They're sold at the point of sale. Here you'll see each one with its balance.
list.noResults: No gift card matches your search
list.loadError: We couldn't load the gift cards

detail.title: Card {{last4}}
detail.subtitle: Balance, sale details and history.
detail.loadMoreError: We couldn't load more entries. Try again.

actions.title: Manager actions
actions.none: There are no actions for this card.
actions.notePlaceholder: What happened, in a few words
actions.inDoubt: We don't know if it was saved. Tap «Try again»: it won't be applied twice.
actions.inDoubtBefore: Your previous attempt is in doubt. Check the history: if it's already there, don't repeat it.

errors.noteForOther: With «Other reason», write a note of at least 5 letters.
errors.noteTooLong: The note can't be longer than 500 characters.

adjust.title: Adjust balance
adjust.description: Current balance: {{balance}}. The adjustment stays in the history with your name.

errors.amount: Write an amount above zero, for example 150 or 150.50.
errors.moreThanBalance: You can't remove more than the balance ({{amount}}).
errors.overCap: A card's balance can't go over {{amount}}.
errors.note: Write a note of at least 5 letters: it stays in the history.

block.title: Block card
block.description: Nobody can pay with it until you unblock it. The balance doesn't change.

unblock.title: Unblock card
unblock.description: It can be used to pay again.

replace.title: Replace the code
replace.description: A new code is created and the old one stops working. The balance, the validity and the sale don't change.
replace.folioHint: It's the order number on the purchase receipt. It confirms this is the right card.

errors.folio: Write the purchase folio (the order number on the receipt).

replace.newCodeOnce: Write it down or hand it over now: for security you won't see it here again.

cancelSale.title: Cancel the sale
cancelSale.descriptionAll: All the cards of this sale are canceled together. This is how it's canceled:
cancelSale.descriptionSale_one: Sale #{{orderNumber}}: its card ({{amount}}) is canceled. This is how it's canceled:
cancelSale.descriptionSale_other: Sale #{{orderNumber}}: its {{count}} cards ({{amount}}) are canceled together. This is how it's canceled:
cancelSale.step1: We block the cards so nobody uses them.
cancelSale.step2: Give the money back the way it was paid: on the terminal or from the sale.
cancelSale.step3: When the refund is recorded, the cards are canceled on their own.
cancelSale.sameDay: It's only possible the same day of the sale and if it was never used.
cancelSale.started: Cards blocked. Now give the money back from the sale.
cancelSale.inProgressAll: Cancellation in progress: the cards of the sale are blocked. Give the money back from the sale.
cancelSale.releaseDescription: The cards are unblocked and can be used again. Only do this if you CHECKED that the refund did not go through: if it timed out or you don't know what happened, keep the cards blocked and review the sale.
cancelSale.releaseCheck: I checked that the refund did NOT go through (the terminal declined it or it wasn't attempted). If you don't know, keep the card blocked.
cancelSale.released: Done: the cards can be used again.
cancelSale.releaseNotConfirmed: The server answered, but the cards still show as blocked by the cancellation. Check the sale before trying again.
cancelSale.releasedCheckCards: The cancellation was released. Check each card's status before using it.

blocker.NOT_PAID: It can't be canceled: the sale isn't paid yet or its cards aren't active yet.
blocker.NOT_SAME_DAY: It can't be canceled: only on the same day of the sale.
blocker.ALREADY_USED: It can't be canceled: a card of this sale was already used.
blocker.BLOCKED_OTHER: Unblock the card before canceling the sale.
blocker.GENERIC: This sale can't be canceled from here.

aging.title: Live balance at a date
aging.help: How much the still-active cards owe, by how long ago they were sold.
aging.pickDate: Pick a date to see the balance.

pending.title: Pending accounting review
pending.help: These operations don't create an automatic journal entry: a sold gift card is balance you owe the customer, not a sale. Review them with your accountant.
pending.error: We couldn't load the pending items.

export.title: Export balances
export.help: A CSV file with every card that still has balance. Useful for your accountant or if you switch systems.

settings.title: Gift cards
settings.subtitle: Turn them on and choose the amounts and validity.
settings.info: What you set here applies to the cards you sell from now on.
settings.readOnly: You can see this setup, but only a manager or the owner can change it.
settings.refreshError: We couldn't reload the setup. You're seeing the last version that loaded.

switch.title: Sell gift cards
switch.label: Sell gift cards
switch.offDescription: Off: the point of sale doesn't sell cards. To turn it on you need to accept the rules.
switch.onDescription: On: the point of sale sells cards and takes payments with their balance.
switch.downgraded: Your plan no longer includes selling gift cards. You can turn them off; the ones you already sold can still be used to pay.
switch.planUnknown: We couldn't confirm your plan, so they can't be turned on yet.

rules.title: Amounts and validity
rules.description: Applies to the cards you sell from now on. The ones you already sold keep what the customer was told.
rules.suggestedHint: The buttons the cashier will see. They can also type another amount.
rules.limitsHint: From {{floor}} up to {{cap}} per card (legal limit).
rules.validityHint: Recommended: no expiration. If you choose a validity, the customer sees it before paying.

errors.minTooLow: The minimum can't be less than {{amount}}.
errors.minAboveMax: The minimum can't be more than the maximum.
errors.suggestedInvalid: Check the suggested amounts: numbers only, for example 500.
errors.suggestedRequired: Write at least one suggested amount.
errors.suggestedOutOfRange: Suggested amounts must go from {{min}} to {{max}}.

how.sell: They're sold at the point of sale, in a separate check from merchandise.
how.pay: The customer pays with the balance, all of it or part, and the rest with another method.
how.noCash: The balance is never exchanged for cash or transferred.
how.invoice: It's invoiced when it's used, not when it's sold.

activate.title: Before turning on gift cards
activate.intro: These rules protect your business and your customers:

rules.debt: Each card's balance is a debt your business owes the customer.
rules.noCash: It's never exchanged for cash or transferred.
rules.limits: Up to $10,000 per card and less than $70,000 per purchase.
rules.invoice: It's invoiced when the customer uses it.
rules.cancel: It can only be canceled the same day and if it was never used.

deactivate.title: Turn off gift cards?
deactivate.body: No new ones will be sold. The ones you sold can still be used to pay, and you keep seeing them here.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this. Ask whoever manages the business.
